messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager SEV-2: multiple pods in llm-prod-infer-42 are logging repeated NCCL TIMEOUTs and CUDA Xid errors. Alert: https://infra/alerts/2129998888. Suspected multi-gpu collective failure during live traffic.

sre-oncall: acked. i'm taking this. which nodes/pods are showing the failures and any customer reports yet?

eng-runtime: seeing 6/8 replicas with patterns: 
```
\[E\] NCCL WARN Timeout waiting for recv op, rank 3, timeout 120000
\[E\] NCCL ERROR Unhandled internal error
2026-03-15 05:07:13 cuda: cudaErrorIllegalAddress at kernel launch
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/srv/infer/worker.py", line 410, in forward_step
    comm.broadcast(tensors)
```
Some pods report `NCCL WARN Call to cudaGetDeviceProperties failed` then `Failed to init communicator`.

ml-runtime: paste of node mapping: pods on nodes node-31, node-32, node-36. node-36 shows kernel and NIC issues in syslog around 05:06:40.

infra-ops: pulled node-36 dmesg: `NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:65:00): 79` at 05:06:41 and `mlx5_core: link event DOWN` several times preceding that. kubelet restarted at 05:06:55. Looks like IB link flap then GPU driver Xid 79 reset.

sre-oncall: grabbing pod logs for llm-prod-infer-42-2.
```
$ kubectl logs llm-prod-infer-42-2 -c runtime
... nccl: rank 3 lost, waiting for rendezvous, retrying
... nccl: fatal error, hanging
```

eng-runtime: given node-level flaps mid-rendezvous, NCCL communicators can deadlock. short-term plan: cordon node-36, drain it, and restart affected replicas on healthy nodes. also patch deployment env to increase NCCL_TIMEOUT and enable NCCL_DEBUG=WARN so new pods tolerate transient IB blips.

sre-oncall: cordoning node-36 now. `kubectl cordon node-36`

sre-oncall: draining node-36, evicting pods. `kubectl drain node-36 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force` (drain in progress, ETA ~3m).

eng-runtime: while drain runs, applying temporary env changes so replacement pods come up with safer defaults:
```
kubectl set env deployment/llm-prod-infer-42 NCCL_TIMEOUT=200000
kubectl set env deployment/llm-prod-infer-42 NCCL_DEBUG=WARN
```

ml-runtime: enabling runtime fallback for critical routes so if collectives fail the job falls back to single-gpu decode: updating feature flag `FALLBACK_SINGLE_GPU=true` in config map and toggling rollout for safe ramp. This will protect latency-sensitive customers.

customer-success: heads-up: two customers (acct: acme-inc and big-data-co) have reported spikes in 5xx and latency starting ~05:06 UTC. informing them we're mitigating and will follow with an incident update.

infra-ops: drain completed; node-36 cordoned. new pods scheduled onto node-31 and node-32. collecting `nvidia-smi -q` and full journal from node-36 for vendor ticket.

eng-runtime: new pods are initializing with NCCL_TIMEOUT=200000. early logs show successful communicator inits. sample:
```
NCCL INFO Comm init success (ranks 8)
worker: init warmup complete
```

ml-runtime: monitoring metrics: error rate dropped back to baseline after reschedule. customer-success: please hold off major customer update until we confirm root cause.

infra-ops: hypothesis: intermittent mlx5 firmware/driver bug causing IB link flaps -> GPU driver Xid 79 -> kernel-level resets -> NCCL hangs for multi-node/multi-gpu jobs. next actions: schedule mlx5 firmware update and GPU driver patch on node-36, run hardware soak tests.

eng-runtime: action items assigned in INC-2026-211:
- infra-ops: firmware & driver upgrades, hardware diagnostics on node-36 (blocked until maintenance window if needed)
- eng-runtime: set NCCL_TIMEOUT default for multi-gpu pools and add a worker-level guard to fail-fast after repeated NCCL ERRORs (3 errors within 30s) and allow graceful fallback
- ml-runtime: add liveness probe for collective stalls (detect repeated NCCL WARN/ERROR patterns) to restart stuck pods instead of leaving them hung
- product-observability: add a console metric and alert for collective failure rate and Xid count to surface to SLO dashboards

sre-oncall: mitigation status: services operational, replacing failed pods restored capacity. tagging incident as mitigated for paging purposes, keeping node-36 cordoned pending remediation.

customer-success: sent interim notifications to affected customers with timeline and mitigation steps. they requested RCA and ETA for permanent fix (firmware schedule). told them 48-72h for vendor engagement and patching plan.

infra-ops: note for postmortem: when you see GPU Xid 79, collect full dmesg and `/var/log/messages`, gather `nvidia-smi -q` output and IB stats (`ibstat`, `ethtool -S`) before restarting kubelet. do not escalate by rebooting without logs.

eng-runtime: will draft postmortem and update runbooks to include the above data collection steps and add a recommendation for per-job single-gpu fallback for latency-sensitive traffic. also prepping a small PR to set NCCL_TIMEOUT=120000 for all multi-gpu serving pools as an interim conservative default.

ml-runtime: suggestion to capture rendezvous timelines and pod->node allocation at time of error to see if scheduling could reduce cross-node collectives under flapping network conditions. adding to RCA checklist.

sre-oncall: final: incident duration ~00:30, customer impact window ~00:12, affected customers notified. handing off RCA and remediation tasks to eng-runtime & infra-ops. closing pager thread. :lock:
